facts.text: I want to generate a knowledge graph from the provided FAQ and I asked for suggested entity classes to use.
KrisFlyer (KF) members can use KF miles as payment or partial payment of commercial tickets and selected ancillaries on singaporeair.com (SAA).
KF members can use this payment option for all commercial booking classes available on SAA.
KF members can control the number of miles they want to use as long as it is more than the minimum required.
A minimum of approximately 1050 KF miles is required per transaction (per PNR).
The SGD to KF miles conversion rate is SGD 1 per 105 KF miles.
KF members can pay up to 100% of the commercial ticket using miles, inclusive of airport taxes and surcharges.
Purchase of miles is not available for this payment method; purchase of miles is only available when redeeming award tickets or flight upgrades.
KF members can use miles to pay for airport taxes and surcharges on commercial tickets bought on SAA.
KF members can use their miles to pay for the commercial tickets of their nominees (RGN) only.
KF members can nominate up to a maximum of 5 RGN nominees.
Once RGN nominees are added, they cannot be removed or changed for a period of 6 months and a fee is applicable.
KF members can only use their miles for SIA operated flights.
If an itinerary on SAA includes a codeshare flight operated by another airline, KF miles cannot be used to pay for the SIA operated flight within that itinerary.
The KF miles payment option is only available for KF members via SAA and not via travel agents.
Itineraries originating from outside Singapore are priced in local currencies and local fares are converted to SGD before being converted to KF miles using IATA rounding logic.
KF members can accrue PPS Value, Elite miles, and KF miles when they use miles as payment for their commercial ticket.
KrisFlyer and Elite miles are earned in proportion to the fare excluding airport taxes paid using credit/debit card if the fare is mileage accruable.
PPS Value accrued is derived from the proportion paid using credit/debit card.
KF miles used to pay for a transaction first offset all airport taxes of all the tickets before being used to offset the fare and fuel surcharges.
Elite miles and KF miles accrued on tickets that are partially paid for using KF miles can only be accrued to the KF account.
Miles accrued on tickets partially paid for using KF miles cannot be parked with any other OFFPs.
KF members cannot opt to accrue miles for other KF members before themselves.
Miles earned from a commercial ticket paid for with KF miles can only be credited to the member’s KF account.
Commercial tickets paid for with KF miles are strictly non-endorsable.
Redemption upgrades are allowed for tickets paid for with KF miles as long as the commercial fare is in an upgradeable booking class.
For flight or itinerary changes, members must contact their local SIA office or call centres.
Any additional collection resulting from changes can only be paid for using credit card, debit card, or cash.
Members can submit booking change requests via SAA which are routed offline for handling.
For seat and meal requests, members can self-service on SAA.
Offline assistance for issuing tickets paid for with KF miles by AROs/call centres is for exceptional handling only.
This payment feature is only available on SAA, so if SAA is down KF miles are not available as a payment option.
Members can continue the transaction offline if SAA is down, but payment must be made using credit/debit card.
Members can make seat and meal requests on SAA for tickets paid for with KF miles even if the tickets were reissued offline by AROs/call centres.
Tickets paid for with KF miles can be submitted for refunds on SAA if the tickets are completely unflown and have not been reissued.
For refunds, the maximum amount paid using credit/debit card is refunded first, not exceeding the original amount paid using credit/debit card.
The balance of a refund is refunded in miles.
KF miles that have expired are not refunded.
For cancellations, the cash amount is refunded first (not exceeding the original amount paid using credit/debit card) before refunding KF miles.
Residual value refund logic for reissuance from a higher fare to a lower fare refunds cash first and then refunds any balance in miles.
Expired miles used at the point of refund are not refunded.
Any applicable fees and charges associated with the refund are deducted from the oldest miles used for the ticket.
Information on the expiry of the miles used for tickets is available in the transaction record in MARMS.
Members can submit tickets paid for with KF miles for refund on SAA or by contacting their nearest SIA office.
For tickets submitted for refund offline, these tickets must be refunded by the original issue station.
When a refund is successfully completed, the miles are returned to the member’s account immediately.

The KF miles payment option is only available on SAA for new ticket issuance and cannot be used for additional collection resulting from a reissuance when the original ticket was paid fully with credit/debit card.
KF miles are only available as a payment method for commercial tickets.
KF miles cannot be used to pay for taxes and surcharges on redemption award tickets in the current phase.
OFFP members (e.g., LH Miles & More members using LH miles) cannot use their own miles for this payment option; only KF miles can be used.
KF members can continue to redeem Saver, Standard, and Full Award tickets.
Infant nominees are not available in the dropdown list on SAA currently, but members will be able to pay for infant tickets with miles once the feature is made available.
Members can book for themselves and their nominees and pay with miles only for themselves and their nominees.
Members must pay for any other passengers who are not nominees using credit/debit card.
For tickets paid for with miles with itineraries starting from MI destinations, MI cannot service reissue/revalidate/refund; the tickets must be routed to SQ for handling.
When voiding a reissue of a ticket originally paid for with miles, the FOP for the reissue must be deleted before attempting another reissue.
Voiding the refund of a ticket originally paid for with miles is not allowed even when sales report is not closed yet.
Refund of tickets paid for with miles must be refunded by the original issue station to avoid refund failure due to exchange rate handling differences between BBR and MARMS.
Cover refund is permitted for a flown ticket but not for an already refunded ticket for tickets paid for with miles.
Zero refund is not allowed for tickets paid for with miles because MARMS expects FOP details and there is no FOP for zero refund.
For reissue of tickets paid for with miles, only cash is allowed if additional fare is required.
FQTR is mandatory for such reissues because MARMS needs the FQTR number from Altea to create the MARMS record for the reissue transaction.
If the principal member chooses 'Not a nominee' and enters the 2nd pax details manually, the principal member cannot use miles for the 2nd pax.
In the 'Not a nominee' scenario, the principal member gets either partial/no accrual while pax 2 gets full accrual.
A residual value eMD issued against a ticket paid for with miles cannot be reissued into another ET or eMD in phase 1; it must be submitted for refund.

cover refund flown vs already refunded
SAA down offline transaction credit/debit card

events.text: Nominees (RGN) cannot be removed or changed for a period of 6 months after being added.
The KF miles payment feature is only available on SAA; if SAA is down, KF miles are not available and the transaction must be completed offline with credit/debit card.
Refund processing returns miles immediately once the refund is successfully completed.
Residual value eMD reissue into another ET or eMD is not in scope for phase 1 and must be submitted for refund; reviewed by LMD in phase 2.
